title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 1: the call of Jeremiah, the almond branch, the boiling cauldron, and the promise that Yahweh is with him.

questions.text: Whose son was Jeremiah, and where was he from?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah was the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.

answers.text: The son of Amoz, from the city of Jerusalem
The son of Hilkiah, from Anathoth in the land of Benjamin
The son of Josiah, from the town of Bethlehem
The son of Asaph, from the city of Hebron

questions.text: In the days of which king did Yahweh's word first come to Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

answers.text: Josiah the son of Amon, in the thirteenth year of his reign
Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, in his first year
Zedekiah the son of Josiah, in his eleventh year
Hezekiah, in his fourteenth year

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he did before forming Jeremiah in the womb?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you," and appointed him a prophet to the nations.

answers.text: He named him
He crowned him
He knew him
He hid him

questions.text: What objection did Jeremiah raise when he was called?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said, "Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, I don't know how to speak; for I am a child."

answers.text: That the people would not believe him
That he was a man of unclean lips
That he was the least in his father's house
That he did not know how to speak, for he was a child

questions.text: What did Yahweh do when he stretched out his hand to Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: Yahweh touched Jeremiah's mouth and said, "Behold, I have put my words in your mouth."

answers.text: He placed a burning coal on his lips
He touched his mouth and put his words in it
He wrote his words on a scroll for him
He anointed his head with oil

questions.text: What did Jeremiah see in his first vision?
questions.explanation: When Yahweh asked what he saw, Jeremiah said, "I see a branch of an almond tree."

answers.text: A branch of an almond tree
A basket of summer fruit
A measuring line in a man's hand
A scroll flying through the sky

questions.text: What did Jeremiah see the second time Yahweh's word came to him?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said, "I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north."

answers.text: A burning bush that was not consumed
A plumb line against a wall
A boiling cauldron tipping away from the north
An olive tree with two branches

questions.text: From which direction did Yahweh say evil would break out on the inhabitants of the land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land."

answers.text: Out of the south
Out of the east
From beyond the sea
Out of the north

questions.text: For what wickedness would Yahweh utter his judgments against them?
questions.explanation: He would judge them because they had forsaken him, burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.

answers.text: They forsook Yahweh, burned incense to other gods and worshiped their own handiwork
They refused to keep the Sabbath day and the appointed feasts
They oppressed the poor and the needy in the gates of the city
They made alliances with Egypt and trusted in horses and chariots

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he had made Jeremiah against the whole land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls," and that they would fight against him but not prevail.

answers.text: A watchman standing on a high tower
A hammer that breaks the rock in pieces
A fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls
A sharp threshing instrument with teeth
